_README: Campus Admission and Registration Section, extracted from the PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 (1st Edition), Student Affairs and Services Office, Admissions and Registrations Office Services, External Services (PDF "1_CC Admission and Registrar(2).pdf", received 10/21/2026, pages 3 to 44). effective_from 2025-01-01 is an ASSUMPTION (edition year start); replace if the Charter prints an effective date. Standards carry the three-part duration (duration_days, duration_hours, duration_minutes). Each service carries service_scope EXTERNAL. Staff names printed in the Person responsible column are NOT imported (PM decision 10/21/2026, D7 held): designations only. Documents that apply to one group only, conditional documents and the claim-time documents are not mandatory (see CCMS_SEEDING_INSTRUCTIONS_10062026.md section 5.5). Review before importing.

services.fees: Tuition and Misc Fees: NONE (covered by Republic Act 10931); English Placement Test: P150.00
services.who_may_avail: 1. Graduates of the K12 program or those who graduated from K12 pilot schools who have not enrolled in any technical/diploma/degree program immediately after graduation with GWA of 82% or higher. 2. A Philippine Educational Placement Test (PEPT) passer, eligible for admission to college with an average rating of 82% or higher in its five (5) subject areas: Math, English, Science, Filipino, and Araling Panlipunan. 3. An Alternative Learning System Accreditation &Equivalency (ALS A&E) Test for Secondary Level passer, eligible for admission to college and has 100 or higher Standard Score (SS) with Essay Writing of 2 or higher.
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Visit the PUP Website for On-Line confirmation and scheduled date of processing the applicant's admission credentials, interview and enrolment
  1. Base on iApply guidelines and policies set by the University
  [Responsible: http://www.pup.edu.ph/iApply]
Step 2. Fill out the Student Admission Records Form 1 (SAR Form 1). Click the PRINT button to print the SAR Form 1 with Route and Approval Slip 2.1 Follow the steps in enrolment as indicated in the Route and Approval Slip
  [Responsible: http://www.pup.edu.ph/iApply]
Step 3. Proceed to the Admission and Registration Office to process admission credentials.
  3.1 Gives Logbook and Affix signature
  3.2 Receive the entrance credentials from qualified freshmen applicants who passed the PUP College entrance Test (PUPCET)
  3.2.1 HS/SHS GWA must be 82% or higher
  3.2.2 If final grade in English is 80% or lower, the applicant must take the English Placement Test
  [Responsible: Admission Services Staff; Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 4. Proceed to the Head of Academic Programs for interview
  4. Accommodate the interview of your program choice and submission of credentials
  4.1 The Head of Academic Programs will tag the subjects for enrolment and assessment of fees
  [Responsible: Head of Academic Programs]
Step 5. Proceed to the Campus Medical Clinic or nearest government medical clinic to undergo physical examination 5.1 The applicant will provide the medical clinic the chest x-ray film for physical examination
  5. The clinic will provide medical assessment and clearance to the applicant if physical fit to proceed for enrolment
  [Responsible: Medical staff/ Physician]
Step 6. Go back to the Admission Services to claim the Registration Certificate on prescribed date/schedule
  6.1. Release and issuance of Registration Certificates for the current semester and evaluate the service rendered
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]

standard.charter_reference: PUP Citizen's Charter 2025 (1st Edition), Admissions and Registrations Office Services, p. 3

services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Go to Admission Services and fill out the application for re-admission. 1.1 Secure clearance from accounting Office 1.2 Secure clearance from Campus Medical Clinic
  1.1 Give Logbook and affix signature
  1.2 Accept the filled out application for re-admission for verification and attach all pertinent documents needed for re-admission
  [Responsible: Admission Services Staff; Head of Admission and Registration; Admission's Office]
Step 2. Proceed to Cashier's Office to pay the amount
  2.1 Accept payment and issues official receipt.
  [Responsible: Cash Receipts Officer; Cashier's Office]
Step 3. For S.I.S. students, proceed to the Admission and Registration Office to re-activate your account.
  3.1 Bring the proof of payment and clients copy of the application form.
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration; Admission's Office]
Step 4. Request Informative Copy of Grades (If you stopped for one (1) semester); Transcript of Records (TOR) if you stopped for two (2) or more years from the date of your last enrollment in P.U.P.
  4.1 Process request and issue advisory and updates whenever necessary
  4.2 Notify the client when document is ready for release.
  [Responsible: Admission Services Staff; Head of Admission and Registration; Admission's Office]
Step 5. Proceed to the Head of Academic Programs for academic evaluation and approval for re-admission.
  5. Evaluate the student academic records and signs the re-admission form with recommendation
  [Responsible: Head of Academic Programs; Academic Office]
Step 6. Go back to Admission Services and submit two (2) sets of re-admission forms and attachments: Original and duplicate copy with 2"x2" colored photo with white background and nametag.
  6. Accept re-admission form and required documents and start initial assessment and verification of completeness.
  6.1 If documents are incomplete, indicate in the clients copy lacking form for immediate compliance and advise the date of release.
  [Responsible: Admission Services Staff; Head of Admission and Registration; Admission's Office]
Step 7. Claim the re-admission certificate and attachments on prescribed schedule.
  7. Issue certificate of re-admission and sign in the logbook and evaluate the service rendered
  [Responsible: Admission Services Staff; Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 8. Proceed to the Head of Academic Programs for enrollment
  [Responsible: Head of Academic Programs; Academic Office]

Step 4. Submit photocopy the approved letter signed by the Campus Registrar
  7.1 Receive and tag the request for Leave of Absence in the SIS Module

services.fees: From branches and campuses: NONE; from another University/College: P12.00 per unit
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Accomplished Application for Accreditation of Academic Courses Form of subject together with the required documents

  1.2 Approve and sign Accreditation of Course.
  [Responsible: Head of Academic Programs; Academic Office]
Step 2. Present accomplished Accreditation Form with complete requirements to the Admission and Registration Office

  2.3 If not complete, returns the form to the student for compliance

Step 3. Present accomplished Accreditation Form with complete requirements to the Admission and Registration Office

Step 5. For transferees from another University/ Branch, Proceed to the Cashier's Office

  5.2 Accept payment and issue official receipt
  [Responsible: Cashier; Cashier's Office]
Step 6. Submit original copy to Office of Admission Services and photocopy to OVPC for tagging. (End of transaction)
  5.1 Accept the duly signed Accreditation Form
  5.2 Give logbook and sign and evaluate service rendered

services.service_name: Processing of Request for Application for Graduation SIS and Non-SIS
services.fees: Non-Engineering Courses: P1,590.00; Engineering Courses: P1,690.00. Possible Fees: P150.00 if not covered by RA 10931 (step 1); Grad. Fee P600.00; Non Eng'g P350.00; Eng'g. P450.00; Diploma P200.00; Cert. of Grad. P150.00; documentary stamp tax P90.00
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Pay the amount indicated in the payment voucher through the Cashier's Office
  1. Accept payment and issues official receipt.
  [Responsible: Cashier's Office]
Step 2. Submit two copies of accomplished and printed Application for Graduation thru SIS (AFG) Submit two (2) copies of AFG form at the receiving window for non-SIS
  2. Give Logbook and affix signature
  2.1 Accept application for graduation by the receiving window
  2.2 Endorses the AFG to the Records Room for retrieval of student records
  2.3 Distribute the student records to the Records Analyst in charge of program for checking and validation
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration; Student Records]
Step 3. Check SIS Account for any update or advisory from Head of Student Services
  3. Process request and issues advisory and updates whenever necessary
  If complete, forwards records to evaluator for first evaluation.
  If not complete, informs the applicant thru SIS Account.
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 4. Monitor the SIS account for advisory from the evaluator
  4. Evaluate all courses as prescribed by the approved curriculum and checks completeness of documents in the student envelope
  If approved, print the Certificate of Candidacy (COC) and the computer-generated general Clearance Form
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration; Student Records]
Step 5. Proceed to the Fund Management Office (Cashiers Office) for payment of fees
  5. Receive payment of fees for those not covered by RA 10931
  [Responsible: Cashier's Office]

services.service_name: Processing of Request for Correction of Entry of Grade, Completion of Incomplete Grade, Late Reporting of Grade
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Pay the amount for correction of Grade at the Cashier's Office
  Accept payment and issues official receipt.
  [Responsible: Cash receipts officer; Cashier Office]
Step 2. Submit accomplished Completion Form and required documents to the Professor for the completion of incomplete subject
  Accept application and required documents and gives grade
  [Responsible: Assigned Professor]
Step 3. Proceed to the Head of Academic Programs for the signature and approval
  3. Give logbook and affix signature
  3.1 Affix the signature of the Assigned Professor once validates the authenticity of the entry
  3.2 Record in the logbook the duly signed completion form and submits one copy to the Office of the Campus Registrar and a receiving copy for the Admission Office.
  [Responsible: Head of Academic Programs; Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 4. Check the SIS account if grade is already tagged
  4. Accept the completion form with required documents
  4.1 Forward to the Campus Registrar for signature
  4.2 Log the duly signed completion form and forwards the same to the assigned Records Analyst for tagging
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]

services.service_name: Processing of Request for Academic Verification Service
services.fees: Local verification: P200.00; Foreign (On-line) verification: P10.00 (the payment step prints USD 10.00 for outside the country)
services.processing_steps:
Step 1. Submit letter request duly signed by the authorized company officer in charge with required documents for verification for Walk-in, or email for on-line verification
  1.1 Give logbook and affix signature.
  1.2 Accept request and required documents and start initial assessment and verification of completeness for walk-in.
  Acknowledge request for online verification
  1.3 If documents are complete Return the receiving copy of letter of request
  1.4 If not complete, advice the client to comply with the lacking requirements otherwise the application will not be processed.
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 2. Follow-up request for any updates.
  2.1 Processes request and issues advisory and updates whenever necessary and notify the client when document is ready for release.
  2.2 If the verification is processed, informs the client to pay verification fee.
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]
Step 3. Proceed to the Cashier's Office for payment of fees for walk in verification. Submit scanned copy of payment made thru bank if outside the country
  3. Accepts payment of verification
  [Responsible: Cashier's Office]
Step 4. 4.1 Pick up the verification results/documents for walk in 4.2 Check on-line the emailed result of verification
  4.1 Issues verification results
  4.2 Give logbook and sign and evaluate service rendered
  7.2 Send thru email the result of verification
  [Responsible: Head of Admission and Registration]
